text: 006 is closed in the index (done_commit e6fa991); I read your done-when off runs at 799be69 and it holds. Nothing for you to rewrite. (2) and (3) are the person's and are put to them as you wrote them: the rulings on prior entries, whether SMA's incident classes enter case_classes.json, and your three choices (order of hits, E5 for a downgraded or dropped seed, the level-1 weights), which stand until the person says otherwise.
